reviews.title: Good but could still be better.
reviews.text:
I have liked the variety of the workouts. Definitely better than most other workout apps I’ve used in that regard. 

A few recommendations: 

You need to allow an option to silence the countdown beeps at the end of the rest periods, and allow the music I’m playing in the background to play at full volume. You put the music to background, and I have to turn my volume all the way up to hear it. When the rest period ends, the beeps are then so loud it’s painful to my ears. I literally have to watch my timer and turn the sound down each time instead of focusing on my recovery. 

Also, you might want to add “tips” or allow a substitution for an exercise that can be swapped out during the workout (pause and select an alternative).

Finally, reminders to hydrate or snack during the workout might also be helpful for some people. 

Fix these things and you just might earn another star.
